buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder should be OEM or Authorized by OEM for this bid and should upload BID specific authorizatio n from OEM (Signed & stamped copy) along with bid documents. 2. The bid has to be quoted by bidder for fire extinguishers with Valid BIS License Certificate with BIS Prod uct Listed Endorsement Certificate for IS 16018 & IS 15683. 3. The bidder/OEM must submit valid NABL-accredited laboratory test reports for all quoted products as pe r mentioned in Bid and same should be uploaded at the time of bidding. 4. OEM should be registered in State Pollution Control board, CE marked certificate, ISO 45001, & ISO-900 1 for wheeled fire extinguishers whereas registered in CE marked certificate, ISO 45001, & ISO-9001 for po rtable fire extinguishers within the last one year from the bid submission date and the same should be upl oaded while submitting the bid. 5. The bidder must quote and participate for all items/products mentioned in the Bid. Any bidder who fails to quote for all products shall be marked as disqualified and the bid will be rejected . 6. Test Certificates and Warranty/ Guarantee Certificates to be submitted at the time of delivery. 7. A minimum fire rating of 233B for B class fire for 45ltr water mist (IS 16018) is mandatory for participati

on. 8. Bidder shall submit scanned copy of Valid GST Registration Certificate, Latest ITR & pan card. 9. EMD in form of DD/FDR as per NIT shall be deposited amounting to Rs =30000/- in favour of EE (E&M) M -13. 10.The firm should submit undertaking that it’s no near relative is working in DJB, if relative working in DJB then relation must be given 11. Bidders shall have to submit the scanned copy FDR/DD against EMD with the bid documents and submi t Original/Hard copy to this office within 01 working day of the opening of technical bids so that same can b e considered for opening of bid. 12. Documents submitted by the contractor should be legible/readable/visible, etc. failing which tender wil l liable to be rejected. It is mandatory to attach all documents as required with technical Bid of NIT. 13. Allied rules & regulations prevailing in DJB will also be applicable. 14. Payment after satisfactory Completion of Supply at site. 15. Guarantee of the work shall be for a period of 12 months from the date of Completion. .
